gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Loose, rope-like, wonderfully wobbly. Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width through every stem and bowl, while ZCOOL XiaoWei sits underneath as a sans with a gentle taper, like a sharpened pencil line.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi stays low and uncluttered. Underdog above it bends its lines like straws and opens each curve like a horseshoe, and that bold, springy contrast with the quiet sans-serif beneath is the pair's real draw.
